description: Head C golden set, written before the assistant was implemented (course §3.4): 15 policy questions with an expected source, 10 requiring a specific tool call, 8 out of scope, 7 in French. expected_tool is the first tool the assistant must choose; out_of_scope means it must refuse. customer_ref is the signed-in customer (a demo customer from artifacts/demo_customers.json).
